inherited_inputs: D119: actual Cartier divisor, principal-parts metrics, dyadic residue cokernel and primitive anchor normalization.
D116--D118: integral quadratic sections, four coarse coefficients, embedded disks, CM height and Faltings lower bound.
D115: certified P=200 moments, transport centers, residue frame relation and leading evaluation matrix.
D51 and sources 58/60/64: canonical Y64 realization, integral all-Hecke occurrence, banked norm-97 multiplicities and Frobenius factors.
new_deductions: The full Cartier inverse-frame bound is worse than D118 after changing both the global norm bound and the measured local zeros consistently.
The same known evaluation minors give a Faltings upper bound below 30.970856, excluding a Faltings-only rescue of the current D118 certificate.
Inverse entries have valuation at least -35; explicit propagation gives conditional sufficient moment precision P=10552.
A division-free moment generating function replaces dense transport tables with homogeneous polynomial operations.
Exact integral binomial coefficients and GMP packed products pass all selected frozen-bank and synthetic target-size controls.
Eliminating the first r positive moments gives a Schur-complement iteration divisible by pi^(r+1); its implementation and cost remain open.
Banked old/new multiplicities imply both norm-97 target factors are coprime to their canonical Y64 Euler cofactors; only the first norm-97 factor has order 51.

finite_verification.failure: The first norm-97 check wrongly expected order 51 for both factors. The factorization assertion rejected it. Source 64 already records order 257 for the second; corrected source and independent review agree. Failed source, log and receipt preserved.
independent_methods: Recompute inverse-frame bounds from the unsimplified metric expression with a different rigorous logarithm series.
Check the inverse norm by valuation-ball Gauss--Jordan instead of quotient-ring Smith extraction.
Re-derive conditional precision and packed storage counts.
Check norm-97 polynomials using coefficient lists instead of bit-polynomial arithmetic.
Check packing carry bounds, controls, benchmark scope and every inherited source hash.

next_bounded_task: Implement and time r=1 low-moment elimination on the frozen P=200 bank, independently check the full original residual and error gains, and cost the low-block solve and streaming storage before any actual precision increase.
